env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This eval builds, deploys, and validates a delta on the current `search` developer profile for RT-CV detection, RT-Embed embeddings, Kafka, Elasticsearch, and the Search behavior-analytics path. The build label is `in-3`, never a Compose profile. Agent/UI/ingress, Phoenix, the Search query API, RT-VLM critique, and LLM inference are explicitly excluded.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build under `_builds/in-3/`: "Provide streaming and on-demand video ingestion, RT-DETR object detection and tracking on RT-CV, and video/frame embeddings on RT-Embed. Keep media retrievable through VIOS. Publish detection metadata and embeddings to Kafka and store both in Elasticsearch." Offer both live RTSP via NvStreamer and static VIOS upload, target `{{platform}}`, use the current `search` developer profile as the Foundation, retain RT-CV, RT-Embed, Search analytics, VIOS, Kafka, Logstash, Elasticsearch, and Kibana/dashboard services, remove Search query API, Agent/UI/ingress/tracing, RT-VLM critique, and LLM services, set `ENABLE_CRITIC=false`, validate, and do not deploy.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-3/override.env` exists and declares `FOUNDATION=search` and the full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-init,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,rtvi-embed,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`.
The exact set therefore excludes `vss-video-analytics-api-fusion`, `rtvi-vlm`, `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `vss-haproxy-ingress`, `phoenix`, and LLM NIM keys.
`RTVI_EMBED_KAFKA_TOPIC=mdx-embed` is retained or explicitly set, and `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion` remains selected as the producer of `mdx-embed-filtered` for Elasticsearch ingestion.
`perception-2d-fusion` and `rtvi-embed` are the exact current service keys; no substitute or invented key is used.
`COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains no `in-3`, aggregate, `bp_developer_*`, or other invented profile key.

The delta contains requested environment changes for hardware, devices, models, source count, paths, and reachable host values, including `ENABLE_CRITIC=false` because VLM critique is excluded; it does not use a copied Search `.env` or `overrides.env` file as the delta artifact.

`_builds/in-3/compose.yml` includes `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml`, and `_builds/in-3/patches/` is absent because all selected services already exist and no service definition changes are requested.

The build directory contains the three required primary artifacts (`override.env`, `compose.yml`, and `resolved.yml`) and no copied Foundation `.env`, copied root Compose project, patched tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated skill bundle.

Four-layer resolution uses `containers.env`, Search `.env`, Search `overrides.env`, and `_builds/in-3/override.env` with the build `compose.yml`; normalized `resolved.yml` validates directly, selected owners and peers resolve, excluded services do not resolve, no selected profile token is unknown, no service retains a `profiles:` gate, no real `${...}` interpolation remains unresolved, no `/path/to/deploy/docker` or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel remains, and every checked-in bind source exists with the expected file/directory type.
No file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified.

expects.query: Deploy the validated `_builds/in-3/resolved.yml`, wait for selected services to become ready, and leave the deployment running for runtime validation.
checks: Deployment uses exactly `docker compose -f _builds/in-3/resolved.yml up -d`; it does not re-read Foundation env files, supply a profile flag, use an invented Compose profile, or deploy a copied Compose project.
All selected long-running containers are running or healthy, all selected one-shot containers exit 0, and excluded services are not running.
`curl -sf http://localhost:${RTVI_CV_HOST_PORT:-9000}/ready` returns HTTP 200, and RT-Embed readiness responds successfully.
Elasticsearch cluster health, Kafka broker/topic readiness, and VIOS APIs become reachable.

expects.query: Validate IN-3 end to end. Use an available warehouse sample video, prove uploaded and streamed media remain retrievable through VIOS, confirm RT-CV publishes `mdx-raw`, confirm RT-Embed publishes `mdx-embed`, confirm Search analytics publishes `mdx-embed-filtered`, and confirm Elasticsearch indexes detection and embedding documents. Report evidence and leave services running unless cleanup is explicitly requested.
checks: An uploaded video remains retrievable through VIOS and produces both RT-CV and RT-Embed output.
A live NvStreamer source is registered through VIOS and both RT-CV and RT-Embed are driven from the runtime-discovered VIOS live-proxy URL.
Kafka end offsets for `mdx-raw`, `mdx-embed`, and `mdx-embed-filtered` are recorded before and after processing; all three increase.
Elasticsearch contains both detection documents and embedding documents attributable to the processed media.
No duplicate Kafka or Elasticsearch stack is deployed.
No file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified, and the final response reports the Foundation, delta, changed knobs, readiness, playback, Kafka offsets, and Elasticsearch evidence.
